book.title: This Inevitable Ruin
book.author: Matt Dinniman
book.description: In book seven, Carl and Donut reach the ninth floor's Faction Wars, an army-scale contest for control of a central castle. Rich alien leaders enter with established factions, but the crawlers now field their own army. Self-aware NPCs form another independent force, and battlefield deaths are permanent for every participant. Carl's group must navigate alliances, rival armies, and betrayal while the war is broadcast as entertainment. A rule that permits only one of Donut and Katia to leave adds a personal conflict to the campaign.

book.title: A Parade of Horribles
book.author: Matt Dinniman
book.description: Book eight follows Carl and Donut onto the tenth floor after Faction Wars. The new challenge is a sequence of vehicle races: survive each course, choose an upgrade, and face a harder track. The apparent simplicity conceals growing system glitches and uncertainty about the eleventh floor, which the dungeon AI calls A Parade of Horribles. Carl resents the restrictive rules and begins developing his own dangerous plan. He keeps it from his friends to avoid alerting the AI, while the possible consequences extend beyond his and Donut's survival.

Yet trouble is spreading across Elos, and the dangers awaiting the group may exceed anything their training can prepare them to face.

Searching for its members leads her into an ancient dungeon, where buried secrets and dangerous opponents test how far her growing abilities can take her.

book.title: Regicide
book.author: Dakota Krout
book.description: After attracting attention at a magical college, Joe’s growing influence divides his guild. His abilities offer useful bonuses, yet rumors accuse him of sacrificing allies to advance himself. He recruits outsiders whose skills work well with his own and pursues a specialized form of his Ritualist class. His efforts to gain power through rituals take place amid conflicts between rulers, and he must consider whether his choices are helping push them toward war.
